name: Thandai
description: Milk ground with almonds, melon seeds, fennel and pepper — the Holi cooler.

tcm.note: Read from its components; the melon seeds and milk dominate.

ayurveda.note: Built deliberately from shita dravyas — milk, char magaz, saunf and rose.

unani.note: Thanda-tar by design; the name is literally 'the cooling one'.

histamine.note: Almonds and milk are low; it is the nut-heavy base that keeps it modest rather than zero.
